rationale: Genome-wide CRISPRa screen in 143B osteosarcoma cells, two DMSO and two ISX9-treated libraries; genes whose activation blunts ISX9 should be enriched in ISX9. Counts from GSE240870_CRISPRa_raw_count_screen.csv.gz with its second header row (DMSO-1, DMSO-2, ISX9-1, ISX9-2) used as column names; values unchanged. About half the library (one sub-library) has no reads in any sample and is removed by min_total_count; library totals still include all guides. The libraries all correlate 0.97-0.98, so replicate pairing cannot be read from the data and no replicate term is used (2 residual df). The two 'M+I' columns have no GEO sample and are not used.
